title: Pagination
description: Record count on the left, page controls on the right. Prev and Next grey out at the ends. Long lists collapse to the first page, the last page and the pages around the current one, joined by an ellipsis. The Items per page pill opens a menu of 10, 25 and 50 that opens upward; picking one resets to page 1, and clicking anywhere outside closes it.

props.x: Starting page size. The pill cycles 10, 25, 50.
Fires when a page size is chosen from the menu.
